name: FreeToken Provider Index
description: Manifest of provider data files for the FreeToken catalogue. Each entry in 'providers' is the filename of a JSON file in this directory, listed in display order. All provider, model, and family names currently in the data are placeholders — to add a provider, create a new JSON file here following the schema in SCHEMA.md, then append its filename to the 'providers' array. No changes to app/index.html are required — the app discovers providers from this manifest.
